title: Katseye Talks About Performing “Pinky Up” For the First Time At Coachella & “Golden” With HUNTR/X | Billboard News
summary: KATSEYE talks about performing their new song “Pinky Up” at Coachella 2026 weekend 1, how they feel about the choreography compared to some of the other songs and performing “Golden” from Netflix’s ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ with the girls with HUNTR/X.
